Class SessionStatistics

java.lang.Object
com.example.export.SessionStatistics
public class SessionStatistics extends Object
Author:
Ubayd Razack Calculates the summary numbers for a session from its events: event count, successful and failed compilations, and the average time between compiles. Used by both the JSON and the PDF.

  • Method Details

    • averageGapSeconds

      private static double averageGapSeconds(List<Long> times)
      Calculates the average gap between consecutive compile times. The gaps add up to the time between the first and last compile, so the average is that span divided by the number of gaps.
      Parameters:
      times - the times of every compile; sorted by this method
      Returns:
      the average gap in seconds to one decimal place, or 0 if there are fewer than two
